Renders a comment author's identity glyph: a person avatar for `user` authors, an icon chip for `agent` authors. Wrapped in a hover card naming the author unless `bare`.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/comments/CommentAuthor.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { CommentAuthorAvatar } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/comments";
```
